identity.name: Valencia Falls
identity.notes: 55+ single-family community in Delray Beach, FL with 705 units. HOA established 08/17/2000 (Federal ID 651046132), located at 7084 Prado Lake Dr, Delray Beach, FL 33446. Managed by FirstService Residential (2950 N 28th Ter, Hollywood, FL 33020; 954-926-2921). Association website: valenciafalls.org. Utilities: FPL (electric), City of Delray Beach (water, sewer, trash).

fees.note: Resident-verified observed range $817.33/mo (1 data point); not a guaranteed fee — verify with the association. No CDD/special assessment signals reported yet. Rental rule: application required; buyer approval required (55+ community). Median housing cost in the area is $1,416/mo (separate from HOA).

Template listing claims HOA fee includes water, gas, and snow removal; unverified boilerplate (snow removal in FL is implausible) - treat as unreliable and confirm what the $817.33/mo dues actually cover via estoppel/budget.
